description: This bar chart, titled “task count” on the vertical axis, displays the number of tasks associated with various language families, with the horizontal axis listing the language families in alphabetical order from left to right: Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis is labeled “task count” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 10. Each language family is represented by two adjacent bars: a dark blue bar and a light green bar, which appear to correspond to two different task types as indicated by the legend in the top right corner (though the legend’s full label is cut off, showing only “Sa”). The tallest bar corresponds to “IE-Slavic,” with the dark blue bar reaching approximately 45 and the light green bar reaching approximately 42. The “Romance” category has dark blue and light green bars at approximately 25 and 30, respectively. The “IE-other” category shows dark blue and light green bars at approximately 25 and 30. The “Isolate” category has dark blue and light green bars at approximately 5 and 3. The “Semitic” category shows dark blue and light green bars at approximately 35 and 3. The “Uralic” category has dark blue and light green bars at approximately 35 and 30. All bars are unsorted and appear to be grouped side-by-side for each language family, with no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding applied to any specific bar.
